topic: 中小学核心语法：定语从句 (Attributive / Relative Clauses)
teaching_notes:
1. 【核心概念】：定语从句就像给名词穿上的“定制外套”（形容词性从句），专门用来修饰、限定前面的名词（先行词）。引导从句的连接词叫“关系词”，它既是连接路标，又是从句里的“替身角色”。
2. 【语法公式与口诀】：
公式：先行词（人/物） + 关系词（who/which/that/whose/where/when） + 从句。
口诀：修饰名词找先行，关系词选择看两样：一看先行是人物，二看从句缺啥岗（主/宾/定/状）！
3. 【中小学生易错点】：
① 关系词与代词重复：从句中已有关系代词，切记不能再加人称代词（错：The book that I bought it... 正确：去掉it）。
② 介词后面用错词：介词后面只用 which（物）或 whom（人），绝对不能用 that 或 who！
③ 忽略抽象地点：situation, stage, point 等抽象名词作先行词且从句完整时，需用关系副词 where。
4. 【经典例句】：
① The girl who is playing the piano over there is my best friend. (在边上弹钢琴的那个女孩是我最好的朋友。)
② Harry Potter is a magic book which brings endless joy to kids. (《哈利·波特》是一本带给孩子无限乐趣的魔法书。)
③ This is the quiet town where my grandfather spent his childhood. (这就是我祖父度过童年的宁静小镇。)

questions.question: The boy ______ is running on the playground is my brother.
questions.explanation: 先行词是“The boy”（人），从句缺少主语，因此用关系代词 who 指代人。

questions.question: I like the storybook ______ has many colorful pictures.
questions.explanation: 先行词是“storybook”（物），在从句中充当主语，故使用关系代词 which。

questions.question: Look at the dog ______ is sitting under the big tree.
questions.explanation: 先行词是“the dog”（动物/物），从句缺少主语，选项中只有 that 可以修饰物并充当主语。

questions.question: Do you know the teacher ______ teaches us English?
questions.explanation: 先行词是“the teacher”（人），在从句中作主语，故选择关系代词 who。

questions.question: The apples ______ grow on this tree are very sweet.
questions.explanation: 先行词是“The apples”（物），在从句中做主语，可以使用 that 或 which 指代。

questions.question: My sister bought a toy robot ______ can dance and sing.
questions.explanation: 先行词是“a toy robot”（物），从句中缺主语，用关系代词 which。

questions.question: The man ______ car was damaged called the police.
questions.explanation: 从句中的 car 与先行词 The man 是所属关系（那个人的汽车），故用关系代词 whose。

questions.question: This is the nice pencil case ______ my aunt gave me as a birthday present.
questions.explanation: 先行词是“pencil case”（物），在从句中作 gave 的宾语，故选 which。

questions.question: The students ______ won the basketball game felt very excited.
questions.explanation: 先行词是“The students”（人），在从句中作主语，应填入 who。

questions.question: I have a clever parrot ______ can speak a few English words.
questions.explanation: 先行词“a clever parrot”是动物，用关系代词 that 或 which 引导从句。

questions.question: The doctor ______ looked after my grandfather is very patient.
questions.explanation: 先行词“The doctor”为人，从句缺少主语，填入 who。

questions.question: Is this the photo ______ you took during your holiday in Beijing?
questions.explanation: 先行词是“the photo”（物），从句中 took 缺少宾语，用关系代词 which。

questions.question: The girl ______ mother is a nurse is my classmate.
questions.explanation: 从句中的 mother 与先行词 The girl 为所属关系（女孩的妈妈），故选 whose。

questions.question: We visited the museum ______ was built ten years ago.
questions.explanation: 先行词“the museum”是物，且在从句中作主语（was built），故选用关系代词 that。

questions.question: The cake ______ my mom made yesterday tasted delicious.
questions.explanation: 先行词“The cake”指物，从句中 made 缺少宾语，故用 which。

questions.question: The house in ______ my grandparents live was built fifty years ago.
questions.explanation: 考查“介词+关系代词”。介词 in 后不能跟 that，先行词 house 指物，故用 in which。

questions.question: This is the primary reason ______ he was late for the important meeting.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 the reason，从句中不缺主谓宾，表示“……的原因”，用关系副词 why 引导。

questions.question: China is a great country with a long history, ______ attracts millions of tourists every year.
questions.explanation: 考查非限制性定语从句（有逗号隔离）。that 不能引导非限制性定语从句，先行词指物，用 which。

questions.question: All ______ can be done to protect the rare animals has been done.
questions.explanation: 当先行词为不定代词 All 时，关系代词只能用 that，不能用 which。

questions.question: Do you still remember the exact day ______ we first met on campus?
questions.explanation: 先行词是 the exact day（表示具体时间），且从句成分完整，故用关系副词 when。

questions.question: The scientist ______ achievements changed modern medicine received an honor.
questions.explanation: achievements（成就）与先行词 The scientist 是所属关系（科学家的成就），用 whose 作定语。

questions.question: Mr. Smith is the very teacher ______ inspired me to learn computer science.
questions.explanation: 当先行词被 the very（正是那个）修饰时，关系代词优先选用 that。

questions.question: This is the mountain village ______ I spent my memorable summer vacation.
questions.explanation: 先行词为 mountain village（地点），从句“I spent my vacation”结构完整，故用关系副词 where。

questions.question: She brought two smartphones with her, both of ______ were damaged during the trip.
questions.explanation: 考查“代词/数词 + of + 关系代词”结构。修饰物且跟在介词 of 后面，用 which。

questions.question: ______ is reported in the news, renewable energy is gaining popularity worldwide.
questions.explanation: As 引导非限制性定语从句可置于句首，意为“正如……”，代表主句整句话的内容。

questions.question: The senior engineer with ______ I discussed the project yesterday will give a talk.
questions.explanation: 考查“介词 + 关系代词”。介词 with 后面指代人时，只能用宾格形式 whom。

questions.question: We are facing a complex situation ______ effective measures must be taken.
questions.explanation: 先行词为 situation（抽象地点名词），从句主谓宾齐全，关系副词应用 where。

questions.question: Is there anything ______ you would like to add before we finish the meeting?
questions.explanation: 先行词是不定代词 anything 时，关系代词只能用 that。

questions.question: He failed his driving test again, ______ disappointed his parents deeply.
questions.explanation: 非限制性定语从句中，用 which 替代前面整句话所描述的事情（他再次挂科）。

questions.question: This is the first time ______ our school team has won the national championship.
questions.explanation: 在“This is the first/second time that...”固定句型中，从句通常由 that 引导（经常可省略，且从句用完成时态）。
